lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Front down-flange along the +x edge, about 90 deg. In my own perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the apex dot sits on the outer arc (bisector offsets -0.01, -0.09 and +0.04 mm). The line covers the fold corner to corner (372.9 of about 376 mm). The flange (11 mm) is flat and has no hem; patch 13 is only its thickness edge.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Tall tab at the -y front corner, 90.4 deg. In my sections at 25/50/75% the apex is on the outer arc (+0.03, -0.01 and -0.05 mm). Face-on, the fold runs from the tab edge at t of about -1 to the corner relief at about 45 mm, and the line is 0 to 44.7 mm. The tab is flat above the arc (lean 0 deg from z = 6 to 61 mm).

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Tall tab at the +y front corner. The line is fitted between base 2 and band 15 at 98 deg, and its apex is on the tight outer arc in my sections (+0.09, -0.03 and -0.13 mm). Face-on, the fold runs from about -1 to the relief at about 43.5 mm, and the line is 0 to 42.4 mm. Above the arc the tab rolls about 12 deg more, smoothly, over d of about 4-14 mm (R about 50 mm, R/t about 25, no crease), and then stays planar at a lean of about 21 deg. I count that as a gentle roll inside this one fold (about 110 deg in total), not a separate formed bend. Using the full 110 deg would move the bisector apex by only about 0.4 mm.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Short tab at the +y back corner, 90 deg. The line was fitted on the inner skin, but the label apex lies on the OUTER arc: my sections give -0.02, -0.01 and 0.00 mm. The fold spans about -0.5 to 47.5 mm and the line is 0 to 47.1 mm. Both legs are flat beyond 3 mm; the spikes in the slope profile come from the hole and edges.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Short tab at the -y back corner, leaning out: about 66 deg bend (included angle 114). The apex is on the outer arc at 25/50/75% (-0.16, -0.03 and +0.21 mm along the bisector). At 25% the dot is about 0.8 mm to one side of the broad arc crest, but it is still on the skin, under 1 mm. The fold spans about -1 to 47.5 mm and the line is 0 to 47.4 mm. The base tail next to the fold dips at most about 7 deg and recovers by about 20 mm, and the tab leg dips at most about 3 deg. Both are below 10 deg, so neither is a bend.
